question: For subnets on networks shared via the RBAC action `access_as_shared` with target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, list each subnet’s name and CIDR, the RBAC target tenant, the running sum of subnet standard attribute IDs within each IP version group (ordered by standard attribute ID), the deviation of each subnet’s standard attribute ID from the overall average standard attribute ID across these shared subnets, and (for those same subnets) the DNS nameserver-order coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for IPv4 subnets that is above the overall average—along with a normalized coefficient-of-variation ratio (subnet CV divided by the average CV across the returned subnets).

prediction.sql:
WITH SharedSubnets AS (
    SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name AS subnet_name, s.cidr AS subnet_cidr, s.ip_version, s.standard_attr_id, r.target_tenant
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = s.network_id
    WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
      AND r.target_tenant = '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b'
),
WindowedSubnets AS (
    SELECT subnet_id, subnet_name, subnet_cidr, ip_version, standard_attr_id, target_tenant,
           SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY ip_version ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr
    FROM SharedSubnets
),
AvgStdAttr AS (
    SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id) AS avg_std_attr FROM SharedSubnets
),
DnsCv AS (
    SELECT s.subnet_id, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS cv
    FROM SharedSubnets s
    JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = s.subnet_id
    WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    GROUP BY s.subnet_id
    HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0
),
AvgCv AS (
    SELECT AVG(cv) AS avg_cv FROM DnsCv
)
SELECT w.subnet_name, w.subnet_cidr, w.target_tenant, w.running_sum_std_attr,
       (w.standard_attr_id - a.avg_std_attr) AS deviation_from_avg_std_attr,
       c.cv AS dns_cv,
       c.cv / NULLIF(ac.avg_cv, 0) AS cv_ratio
FROM WindowedSubnets w
CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a
JOIN DnsCv c ON c.subnet_id = w.subnet_id
CROSS JOIN AvgCv ac
WHERE c.cv > ac.avg_cv
ORDER BY c.cv DESC

WITH SubnetRouteStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) WITH SharedSubnets AS (
    SELECT s.id AS subnet_id, s.name AS subnet_name, s.cidr AS subnet_cidr, s.ip_version, s.standard_attr_id, r.target_tenant
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = s.network_id
    WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
      AND r.target_tenant = '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b'
),
WindowedSubnets AS (
    SELECT subnet_id, subnet_name, subnet_cidr, ip_version, standard_attr_id, target_tenant,
           SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY ip_version ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr
    FROM SharedSubnets
),
AvgStdAttr AS (
    SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id) AS avg_std_attr FROM SharedSubnets
),
DnsCv AS (
    SELECT s.subnet_id, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS cv
    FROM SharedSubnets s
    JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = s.subnet_id
    WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    GROUP BY s.subnet_id
    HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0
),
AvgCv AS (
    SELECT AVG(cv) AS avg_cv FROM DnsCv
)
SELECT w.subnet_name, w.subnet_cidr, w.target_tenant, w.running_sum_std_attr,
       (w.standard_attr_id - a.avg_std_attr) AS deviation_from_avg_std_attr,
       c.cv AS dns_cv,
       c.cv / NULLIF(ac.avg_cv, 0) AS cv_ratio
FROM WindowedSubnets w
CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr a
JOIN DnsCv c ON c.subnet_id = w.subnet_id
CROSS JOIN AvgCv ac
WHERE c.cv > ac.avg_cv
ORDER BY c.cv DESC

  FROM subnets s

  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'

cv AS (

         STDDEV(d.`order`) / AVG(d.`order`) AS cv
  FROM base b
  JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = b.subnet_id
  WHERE b.ip_version = 4
  GROUP BY b.subnet_id
)
SELECT
  b.subnet_name,
  b.cidr,
  b.target_tenant,
  SUM(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.ip_version ORDER BY b.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_attr_id,
  b.standard_attr_id - (SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id) FROM base) AS attr_id_deviation,
  c.cv AS dns_order_cv,
  c.cv / (SELECT AVG(cv) FROM cv) AS cv_ratio
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN cv c ON c.subnet_id = b.subnet_id
ORDER BY b.ip_version, b.standard_attr_id;
